notes: Claude lists the assets the code needs; ChatGPT produces or approves them; Claude integrates them.
Source art lives in art/ (full resolution). Runtime files in public/assets/ are packed by scripts/pack-assets.py (WebP sprite sheet, 256px portraits).
status: needed -> delivered (art/incoming/) -> integrated (verified in-engine on an iPhone 13 viewport).

P4 (v0.6): the adjudicator repaint and four rival portraits are 'needed'. Until they arrive, the table draws a provisional gold monogram for any character without a portrait (src/ui/TableScene.ts); the Night Clerk and Dock Runner have no brief yet.

P5 (v0.7): seven portraits needed (adjudicator repaint, Mara Quill, Eldric Vale, Bailiff Sable, Sister Rill, Night Clerk, Dock Runner), briefs in docs/art-brief-p5.md. Act II rivals, the Cinder substitutes and the merchants use the provisional gold monogram by design until briefed. None are integrated.

P6 (v0.8): the seven briefed portraits remain needed (docs/art-brief-p6.md, priority: adjudicator, Bailiff Sable, Sister Rill, Mara Quill, Eldric Vale, Night Clerk, Dock Runner). Act III rivals, the Underlamp regulars and the merchants use the documented gold monogram. Nothing is delivered or integrated.

P10 (2026-10-27, Ashen Reliquary): the owner supplied four portraits (Ledger Adjudicator, Lady Vesper, the Sightless Oracle, Sir Corvin), four discipline emblems and the Reliquary back. All pass the machine gates and are delivered; integrated still needs a named reviewer (scripts/check-art.py --approve). Six briefed portraits (Mara Quill, Eldric Vale, Bailiff Sable, Sister Rill, Night Clerk, Dock Runner) remain needed.
